intro.text: The Open Finance Insurance capabilities enable secure, consent-driven access to a customer’s insurance policy data across the UAE’s major insurance sectors. These services empower licensed third-party providers (TPPs) to deliver policy aggregation, switching, advisory, and value-added digital insurance services.
All services are provided with strict consent management, granular permission scopes, and full auditability.
